commands: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '40eac7a504d363a05cd6c235c25146e01bb36ff2'; APK=app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; test -f "$APK"; echo APK_SHA256=$(shasum -a 256 "$APK" | awk '{print $1}'); APKSIGNER=$(find "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/build-tools" -type f -name apksigner 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -n 1); test -n "$APKSIGNER"; echo APKSIGNER=$APKSIGNER; "$APKSIGNER" verify --print-certs "$APK" | grep -E 'Signer #1 certificate DN|Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest|Signer #1 certificate SHA-1 digest'; adb shell pm path io.blueeye | grep '^package:'; adb shell dumpsys package io.blueeye | grep -E 'versionCode=|versionName=' | head -n 2; echo SIGNING_EVIDENCE_PASS
